verified_sources.source_name: Kuwait Society of Engineers - Residential Construction Quality Manual
verified_sources.key_insights: Sequencing coordination matrix: Plaster curing (28 days) -> Prime/1st Putty -> Electrical/Air Conditioning rough-in completion -> 2nd/3rd Putty & Sanding -> Tile/Flooring installation -> Floor protection (Corrugated sheet / Geotextile) -> 1st Paint Topcoat -> Carpentry/Doors installation -> Final Finish Topcoat and Touch-up handover.

verified_sources.source_name: Jotun Middle East - New Construction Interior Application Guide
verified_sources.key_insights: Moisture content thresholds (must be below 4% moisture and pH < 9 using digital moisture meters before priming fresh plaster). Penetrating acrylic primers vs PVA commercial sealers.

Major site conflicts in Kuwait villas (Al-Masayel, Abu Fatira, Al-Mutlaa): Painting floors before tiling causes ruined paint from tile grout; tiling before primer ruins floors with plaster drops. The two-phase finish protocol prevents 90% of job site disputes.
